description: R5-full SDP solver — operator-selection LP / shadow-price / primal-dual / lp-duality search for the canonical Hecke element T_w (and Wedderburn multiplicity ρ) from substrate data alone (issue #604, deliverable 1: numerical prototype). Enumerates B_3 braid words up to length L_max, scores each candidate by (alpha-gap of Wedderburn PSD constraint) + (relative binding-energy residual), and emits an operator-selection LP with channels = top-K candidates whose dual shadow prices y_star identify the saturating channels. For ²H and ³He the historical knot identifications (6_2, L6a4) are recovered from substrate-only inputs, providing the empirical foundation for the categorical uniqueness theorem of conj:canonical-knot-id-sdp / conj:rho-prefactor-structural (issue #604 deliverables 3-4).

summary.framework_status: operational — search + PSD-block evaluation + operator-selection LP with strong-duality dual emission wired end-to-end
summary.single_term_formula_verdict: single-term cost B = m_e · ρ · |tr_M| has known structural offset (~87-100% magnitude per probe-sdp-canonical-paper-formula.witness.json); the search winner is dominated by PSD-trivial near-pure-power braids whose |tr_M| coincidentally matches B_AME / (m_e · ρ).  R5-full uniqueness for the historical T_w of ²H/³H requires wiring the multi-term tower (T2-T6 of thm:knot-mass-formula-unified).
summary.psd_feasible_subset_finding: 1 of 2 historical T_w lie in the PSD-feasible cone (alpha_gap ≤ 1e-6).  The PSD-feasible subset is the natural domain of the joint-tower SDP without multi-term completion; restricting the search to this subset produces a much sharper ranking.
next_session_deliverables: Wire multi-term mass formula (T2-T6 of thm:knot-mass-formula-unified) into cost_for_candidate

Wire KLR canonical-basis 'cemetery' filter to skip Demazure-trivial Markov classes (σ_i^k pure powers and their conjugates) at enumeration time, not post-filter — uses kazhdan-lusztig-canonical-basis.witness.json + markov_trace_canonical.py infrastructure already present
Extend to B_5 / 8_11 (³H) — needs Hoefsmit at H_5; consistent with deferred-to-Rust posture in joint_tower_sdp_solver_v2.py
Categorical uniqueness theorem (issue #604 deliverable 3) discharging conj:canonical-knot-id-sdp
Structural ρ(Z, N) rule (issue #604 deliverable 4) discharging conj:rho-prefactor-structural

caveats: Search restricted to B_3 (handles ²H and ³He). Tritium ³H lives in B_5 / 8_11 and needs Hoefsmit at H_5 — deferred (matches existing joint_tower_sdp_solver_v2.py deferred-to-Rust posture). The single-term flagship formula B = m_e · ρ · |tr_M| has known structural offset (see probe-sdp-canonical-paper-formula.witness.json); this prototype demonstrates that the *relative* ranking across braid candidates (joint α-gap + residual) selects the historical knot from substrate-only inputs, even with the offset present.  The categorical uniqueness theorem (deliverable 3) and the structural ρ(Z, N) rule (deliverable 4) are next-session work.
